primer: Eli Lilly earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS on 53% Q3 volume growth and $18.98B in 9M free cash flow. Yet we reject new capital (TIER_0) on valuation at $1,347.11, or 65.5x free cash flow (1.53% yield vs. 5.04% 10Y Treasury). Our $1,450.00 Base Fair Value yields 0.59:1 at CMP and 1.26:1 at support, while Bear stress cuts value to $1,050.00. In a 10-distribution-day Downtrend with 3.38% cash, we hold zero shares, decline the $9,317 call spread, and keep 100% in USD cash.
